short.scope: All captured values exact. Automatic no-head intermediate chunks intentionally omit final tuple/head and idle-state capture; all45 committed states and heads verified at public return boundaries.

admission_and_ownership: Backend-only session must have been created for this exact BnModel and retain its original host vocabulary/context extents. Wrong owner/config reset rejects before releasing resources.

Preparation includes preallocated token conversion and BF16 head readback buffers in the explicit request host budget. Existing BnSession host arena and shared model/source-cache storage are separate. Exact device/host budgets and one-byte-short failures qualified.
Generation validates model identity and external position before sampling or callbacks, including one-token generation. Whole prompt validation precedes any automatic chunk.

Logits expand BF16 bits to F32; logits/history/session position publish only after readback and final state commit. Read or fence failure poisons request and preserves host output/history/logical position. Reset/reprepare recovers.
Model, backend weights/GPU, and borrowed source I/O/cache outlive requests. Calls sharing model/source I/O are serialized; no concurrent serving claim.
no_logits_and_automatic_chunks: No-logits skips final mHC collapse, output normalization, and vocabulary projection after all45 layers; commits state and preserves host logits.
All45 committed states and subsequent logits compare byte-for-byte between a full-head prefix and an otherwise identical no-logits prefix.

A single nine-token bn_prefill with max batch3 uses3+3+3 internally; first two heads are skipped. All available early tuples plus all45 committed states/heads at public return boundaries match independent unmodified original-operator captures. Uncaptured intermediate idle states and unused heads are not claimed.

sanitizers.cpu: Full session, generation, and transformer test suites, ASAN/UBSAN with leak detection enabled.
sanitizers.actual_cuda_host: Common GLM context harness3+6, all captured values equal release build; budgets, BUSY/restart, no-logits state equivalence, cross-model/position rejection, read/fence failures and reset/reprepare included.
sanitizers.scopes: Changed host controllers/model/session/generation/layout code instrumented. Device kernels unchanged; no new device-instrumentation claim. GCC13 ASAN fake-stack alignment issue and independent Clang rationale recorded in preceding model-binding evidence. No ISA or sanitizer checks disabled.

limitations: Normal model loader topology guard remains. CLI GLM admission and natural-text prompt coherence have not yet been qualified.
Uses fused-recurrent KDA and deterministic chronological sparse selection profile; automatic default HF/vLLM whole-generation or default chunk-KDA parity not established.
Fixture token IDs with real tokenizer/sampler validate shared generation mechanics; they are not natural-prompt quality evidence.
Output-all-positions, speculative generation, GLM continuous batching/KV scheduling, CPU/Metal GLM execution, and performance parity remain unqualified.
